title: Employer and Employee Shares of a SafeStep Redemption
content:
# Accounting Note: How a SafeStep Redemption Is Paid

Under the SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program, a redemption is drawn on the participant's allowance for the product type bought: on every tier, safety footwear is drawn on the tier's safety footwear allowance and prescription safety eyewear on the tier's prescription safety eyewear allowance.

## 1. The employer-paid portion

The employer-paid portion is the lower of the retail price and the participant's remaining allowance for that product type and allowance year as of the purchase. Where the tier covers the metatarsal guard upcharge, a welder's metatarsal upcharge is added to the employer-paid portion beyond the allowance.

## 2. The employee-paid portion

The employee pays the rest less the tier's overage discount percentage, rounded half up to the cent, by a payment method the tier allows, with payroll deduction only where the tier makes payroll deduction available and capped at the tier's payroll deduction limit per purchase.

In words: the retail price less the employer-paid portion is the rest; the rest is reduced by the discount percentage; the reduced amount is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end. Where the retail price does not exceed the remaining allowance, the rest is 0.00 and the employee pays nothing.

### Worked figures (hypothetical prices, balances and rates)

| Retail price | Remaining allowance | Employer-paid portion | Rest | Discount | Employee pays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 200.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 50.00 | 10 percent | 45.00 |
| 110.10 | 100.00 | 100.00 | 10.10 | 15 percent | 8.59 (8.585 rounded half up) |
| 80.00 | 150.00 | 80.00 | 0.00 | 10 percent | 0.00 |

## 3. Eye exam reimbursement

An eye exam receipt is reimbursed up to the tier's eye exam reimbursement per allowance year, drawn from the participant's eyewear allowance.

## 4. Online redemptions

Online redemptions are available where the tier offers online store redemption and carry the tier's online shipping charge to the employer.
